title: Inspect file-table reader 80001E50

source_unit.target_ownership: assembly_functions in file_table.c; no accepted C definition

behavior.input: a0 is consumed as a full-width 32-bit value. Zero returns 0 immediately. Boundary comparison is unsigned (`sltu a0,boundary`), with a zero-extended 16-bit boundary.
behavior.lookup: For nonzero input, return the byte at record offset +3 for the first record whose unsigned boundary at +0 is strictly greater than the input. Equality advances to the next four-byte record.
behavior.termination: A zero boundary in the first record means empty and returns 0xFF. A zero boundary reached after advancing is the sentinel and returns 0xFF. No independent table count or bounds check is present.
behavior.return_abi: Word return: zero for input zero; otherwise either the zero-extended byte at record +3 or 0x000000FF.

caller_sites.result_use: stored as a 32-bit value to D_801C78EC
shifted left 24 and used in returned address/size arithmetic
saved then shifted left 24 in address arithmetic

caller_sites.argument: incoming a0 saved and passed unchanged

caller_sites.result_use: return not consumed in the visible path; jal delay slot sets $s2 to -1
saved then shifted left 24 in address arithmetic
shifted left 24 in the returned address calculation

candidate_trials.hypothesis: Model the four-byte record directly and return on zero boundary.
candidate_trials.mismatch: Original zeroes v0 in the branch delay slot; candidate schedules the table-address lui there.

candidate_trials.hypothesis: Use the observed 16-bit boundary and four-byte advancement as a halfword cursor, keeping a local boundary for the loop.
candidate_trials.mismatch: Same initial delay-slot scheduling mismatch; candidate remains 16 bytes larger.
